items.title: When do we “run out” of oil stockpiles?
items.summary: Investing.com -- In a note to clients on Thursday, Citi analysts said the U.S.-Iran conflict and disruptions to the Strait of Hormuz have driven global observed inventory draws of roughly 3 million barrels per day, or 519 million barrels, between February and August 2026.
